_doc: NOS Design ruling PG-1 (final; Brad asked for one standard across both sites) applied to the SAOC DS-1 routes. Read by checks/gate-pg1.mjs and checks/f3_check.sh. Route list = goldens/standard.json non-gated routes minus the exceptions below; the ids must be a subset of standard.json (f3_check.sh route-list enforces it).

rulings.1: Gap from hero (or sub-nav) to first content is exactly 64px at >=1024 and 48px below. First section has no padding-top and no hairline.
rulings.2: No split h2/body: h2 sits above its body in the 7fr column; the 5fr column is the sticky index.
rulings.3: Drop any h2 whose text equals the h1.
rulings.4: PageHero min-height is clamp(320px,22vw,380px), content-driven; copy centred with the pill; grows only for a longer lede, the facts row or actions.

outOfScopeNote: Home hero, Events list, Societies grid, Contact, 404 (NF-1). Event detail IS in scope: its ShowBand counts as the first content after the hero. Media-kit is admin-gated (standard.json gated:true) so runtime measurement skips it.

heroCenter.verticalNote: heuristic: only applied to a hero that is exactly its min-height; widen here, not in the gate, if the fixed header overlay legitimately offsets copy

nosNote: NOS Site fills nosRoutes ({id,path,firstContent,minH2}) and runs: NOS_BASE_URL=<url> node checks/gate-pg1.mjs <check> --site nos. Not part of this contract's assertions (NOS routes are not ours to name); the same gate and numbers apply.
